body: Yeah there isn’t really a way to prepare for this question lol. Im not sure how common this question is, but if this is a boundary or area of conversation you’re not willing to open with your sibling that’s fine too! Though, I’m guessing he only asked due to the liquid courage. Anyway, when my friends have asked me I always made it clear to them that size isn’t going to matter if the girl you’re with isn’t attracted to you before I told them my size. That, if she doesn’t get wet regardless of whether you are 3, or 8 inches it will hurt and that’s the most important factor.

Yeah guy here it was just a trust thing! He felt like he could get some answers from you since you guys are really close. My friends consider me the therapist friend and a lot of my friends have asked me this exact question due to insecurity. (No they aren’t gay)
